dataset_title: Abstract-level forage development-stage and lactic-fermentation protein-yield observations
license: Aalborg University Research Portal identifies the accepted author manuscript as CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. This record is an attributed abstract-level factual extract; check license applicability before external or commercial redistribution.
geography: Northern Europe; crop trial location is not included in the abstract extract
process: Forage pressing followed by lactic-acid fermentation of green juice and separation of leaf protein concentrate
data_handling: Only aggregate quantitative ranges and qualitative maturity direction explicitly present in the publisher abstract/highlights are transcribed. No individual treatment values were inferred from figures or secondary review tables. Max-only wording is represented as an upper bound, not a symmetric range. Dry-LPC mass is kept distinct from crude-protein mass. No values are converted or mapped to GreenHub defaults.
limitations: Source materials are chicory, red clover, and timothy, not Dutch roadside grass or VARTA feedstock.
The abstract provides aggregate ranges but not individual harvest-stage values, sampling dates, replicate counts, or uncertainty statistics.
Red-clover ranges are not paired with specific development stages in the abstract.
Lactic-acid fermentation results do not parameterize GreenHub's isoelectric or thermal precipitation route.
The accepted author manuscript has a CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 license; check licensing before redistribution or commercial reuse.
suggested_use: Phase 1/4 evidence that maturity changes crop protein extractability and Phase 4 benchmark context for lactic-acid-fermented LPC. Not a roadside-grass seasonal equation, GreenHub recovery factor, product-quality specification, or runtime default.
